title: Celebration (Succession)
premise_summary: "Celebration" is the pilot episode and the first episode of the first season of the satirical comedy-drama television series Succession. It originally aired on HBO on June 3, 2018. The episode was written by series creator Jesse Armstrong and directed by Adam McKay.
